description: You are standing in a quiet forest clearing. Paths lead off in several directions.
You are in a dark, damp cave. Water drips steadily from the ceiling.
You are in a sunny meadow full of wildflowers.
A narrow tunnel stretches ahead, lit by a faint glow.
A shallow river blocks your path. You can see something glinting on the far bank.
Sunlight pours into a small chamber. A chest overflowing with gold sits in the center!
